## Biology

```{r}
library(plotly)
set.seed(1)
L <- runif(150, 20, 55)
W <- 0.012 * L^3.05 * exp(rnorm(150, 0, 0.08))
plot_ly(x = L, y = W, type = "scatter", mode = "markers") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Length (cm)"), yaxis = list(title = "Weight (g)"),
         title = "Length–weight relationship (simulated)")
```

## Fishery

```{r}
d <- subset(read.csv("../data/landings.csv"), species == "Blackspot seabream")
plot_ly(d, x = ~year, y = ~tonnes, type = "bar") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Year"), yaxis = list(title = "Landings (tonnes)"))
```
